Subject: Draft MAP & next steps — Novus Health (post-demo)

Hi Anita — great follow-up from today’s demo, thanks for the time. Per our discussion I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) so we have a single source of truth for milestones, owners, and dependencies. Key points and asks: 

- Target close date (current draft): 2027-05-14 — please confirm if this still works for your procurement cycle.
- Proposed owners: Novus integration owner: Anita Rao; Redwood PM: Lauren Bishop; Redwood Eng contact: Marcus Lin; Novus Security contact: procurement@novushealth.com.
- Dependencies called out: SOC2 evidence review, KMS integration details, and procurement PO issuance.
- Immediate next steps: 1) Review MAP_v1 and confirm owners/target dates, 2) I'll coordinate a short follow-up to align on SOC2 artifacts delivery, 3) we’ll prepare a phase-based rollout if procurement needs it.

Attachments:
- MAP_v1.xlsx (draft)
- SOC2-summary.pdf (placeholder)

I pasted the HubSpot record link here for your convenience: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/NOV-487

Would you be able to confirm owners and whether the May 14 target is feasible by EOD Friday? If not, share a preferred target and any internal blockers so we can re-prioritize milestones.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Anita Rao <anita@novushealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps — Novus Health (post-demo)

Hi Lauren — thanks for the recap and the MAP. I shared the spreadsheet with the integration and procurement teams. A couple of updates from our side that will affect the MAP timeline: 

- Procurement has a monthly freeze for budget approvals this month that pushes new vendor spend approvals to the next cycle. Practically that means we cannot finalize POs until the week of 2027-05-20. I attached the procurement calendar for visibility (procurement-calendar.pdf).
- Given that, we need to be realistic: moving the target close to 2027-06-30 would be safer unless Redwood can support a phased approach that allows us to start a limited pilot earlier.
- Security has requested an early delivery of SOC2 artifacts and a short summary of encryption/KMS options (they'd like to review before vendor sign-off).

If you can propose a Phase 1 that requires minimal procurement commitment (e.g., a short pilot with limited seats), we can try to fast-track approvals. Looping in procurement here: procurement@novushealth.com.

Best,
Anita Rao
Director, IT Integrations
Novus Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@novushealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps — Novus Health (post-demo)

Hi Anita — appreciate the heads up on procurement. I dug into the MAP and drafted a quick replan (attached MAP_v1.1.xlsx) that splits the engagement into Phase 1 (pilot) and Phase 2 (full rollout):

Phase 1 — Pilot (Goal: validate integration and latency/cost targets)
- Owner: Anita Rao / Novus Integrations
- Redwood owners: Priyom Das (technical lead), Marcus Lin (SRE contact)
- Timeline: enable pilot by 2027-06-15 (requires SOC2 summary + sealed test dataset access)
- Deliverables: integration runbook, monitoring dashboard access, 30-day pilot usage forecast

Phase 2 — Full rollout (Goal: scale to production)
- Target close: 2027-09-01 (flexible based on procurement)
- Dependencies: PO issuance, KMS arrangement, final SLA negotiation

Action items for Redwood (we can complete these quickly):
- Provide SOC2-summary.pdf and a short KMS/keys integration note by 2027-04-28.
- Share an initial integration runbook and a small pilot pricing card for procurement review.

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-NOV-487 (internal tracker)

I’ve attached MAP_v1.1.xlsx (re-prioritized milestones) and SOC2-summary.pdf. If that phased approach looks good, Lauren — can you offer a short pilot pricing note we can share with Anita’s procurement team?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Anita Rao <anita@novushealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps — Novus Health (post-demo)

Thanks Priyom and Lauren — the phased plan makes sense and procurement will review a pilot-only ask faster. A few requests before we lock dates:

- Please update MAP_v1.1 so the pilot milestone is clearly labeled and separated from the PO-dependent items. Procurement requires an explicit list of pilot deliverables and the max exposure (dollars) for legal review.
- Procurement also asks if Redwood can offer a 60-day pilot discount (reduced per-seat rate) or a capped spend for Phase 1. procurement@novushealth.com will need the pricing card to proceed.
- Security confirms they'll accept the SOC2-summary.pdf; they asked if you can also include the KMS docs (key rotation policy and where keys are managed).

If you can send an updated MAP and the pilot pricing card by EOW (Apr 30), we’ll aim to get procurement’s initial thumbs-up by May 20 and confirm a June 15 pilot start if approvals go smoothly.

Regards,
Anita Rao
Director, IT Integrations
Novus Health
